column1: # Hand labels for test-video5. Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
# Frame numbers are the ones burned into label-rally-A.mp4 and label-rally-B.mp4.
#   frame   the frame where the racket meets the shuttle. Within 3 or 4 frames is fine;
#           the scorer matches a prediction to a contact within 0.2 s.
#   near    the player in the foreground, light green shirt, "T. OBAYASHI JAPAN".
#   far     the player beyond the net, dark navy.
#   ?       you could not tell who hit it. Use this freely -- it is scored for detection
#           but left out of the hitter figure, which is better than a guess.
# ONE LINE PER RALLY, only if you disagree with the spans below:
# Rally A runs 1674-2462 and rally B runs 3501-3884. Label every contact you can see
# inside them, including serves, and including any contact where the shuttle is barely
# touched. If you are unsure whether something was a contact at all, add it with a note
# saying so -- it is easier for me to discount a doubtful row than to find a missing one.
c 2090 near lift drive lift shot
c 3613 near clear backend late shot
